readings.summary: Make the crash sites in GetObjectInfo (DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0]) safe for metadata symbols by using FirstOrDefault and falling back to Location.None or another available location, so the closed generic struct is still processed and the resolver is generated.
readings.code_difference: Keeps the closed-generic branch calling GetObjectInfo on the metadata type and only guards the location lookups; the type is still collected and the diagnostic logic still runs.

readings.summary: Avoid running GetObjectInfo or validation diagnostics for types from referenced assemblies, skipping or short-circuiting the closed-generic branch for metadata symbols so no location is ever needed.
readings.code_difference: Adds a check in CollectGeneric or CollectCore that skips or changes handling for types without syntax, rather than just making location lookups null-safe. Diagnostics for such types may be suppressed and the formatter may or may not be generated.

readers.framing: the person who filed this issue, later checking whether what shipped is what they asked for

readings.summary: Make the generator and analyzer not throw for metadata-only symbols by guarding the unguarded DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] accesses (use FirstOrDefault / Location.None), so the build is clean and the resolver is generated, including a formatter for the closed generic struct as the existing closed-generic path does.
readings.code_difference: Only fixes the location lookups in the diagnostic paths; the closed generic struct from the referenced assembly still goes through GetObjectInfo and gets a formatter in the app's resolver.

readings.summary: Avoid analyzing/generating for closed generics from referenced assemblies at all (skip GetObjectInfo for types without syntax), so the app resolver is produced without a formatter for Item<int>.
readings.code_difference: Changes TypeCollector to skip or short-circuit metadata generic value types rather than only guarding locations; no formatter is emitted for Item<int> in the consuming assembly.

readers.framing: a QA engineer who has to write acceptance tests for this requirement before any code exists

readings.summary: Make the generator and analyzer not crash by guarding the DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] accesses (use FirstOrDefault/Location.None) so the closed generic struct from a referenced assembly is processed normally and a resolver is generated.
readings.code_difference: Keeps the closed-generic branch calling GetObjectInfo on the metadata type and only replaces the unguarded indexing with null-safe location lookups; the resolver is still emitted, and any formatter for Item<int> is generated as a side effect of normal processing.

readings.summary: Avoid the crash by changing how closed generic value types from referenced assemblies are collected (e.g. skip or short-circuit GetObjectInfo for metadata types), so no formatter for Item<int> is generated in app while the resolver still is.
readings.code_difference: Adds a check in CollectGeneric/CollectCore to bypass GetObjectInfo for types without syntax, instead of just making location lookups null-safe; no generated formatter for the external type.
